poll.source_locator: Crosstabs '11 Senate', Statewide column: James Talarico 44%, Ken Paxton 40%, Undecided 16%
poll.notes: Two-name question (Libertarian not offered), so other null. Poll titled 'TX Election Integrity'; 'This poll was directed by Stefani Buhajla in partnership with Cor Strategies, LLC. Heritage Action paid for all costs associated with this survey.' Release date not printed (Wikipedia access-date 2026-10-28). Weighted to a fixed party target (42 R / 34 D / 24 I).

pollster.weighting_quote: Data were post-stratified using weighted demographic information from the U.S. Census Bureau's Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement and the state election authorities. Survey results were weighted to reflect a target political affiliation distribution of 42% Republican, 34% Democrat, and 24% Independent, and a gender distribution of 48% male and 52% female.
pollster.mode: online panels and automated telephone interviews
